title: How to Reset Your Account Password
content_html:
Overview

This article explains how to reset a forgotten or expired account password without contacting IT.

Prerequisites

  • Access to the registered recovery email or phone number.
  • Company network or VPN connection (for internal accounts).

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Access Login Page: Go to Login and click Forgot Password.
  2. Verify Identity: Request the one-time code sent to your registered email or phone.
    • Enter the code within 10 minutes of receipt.
    • Codes expire after one use.
  3. Generate New Password: Enter a new password that meets policy, then click Reset Password.
    • Minimum 8 characters, 1 number, 1 special character.
  4. Confirm Reset: You will see a status of PASSWORD_RESET_SUCCESS and be redirected to Login.

If the reset code doesn't arrive within 5 minutes, check spam folders before requesting a new one.

title: How to Enable Two-Factor Authentication
content_html:
Overview

This article explains how to enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) to add an extra layer of security to your account.

Prerequisites

  • An active account with a verified email address.
  • An authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator) installed on your phone.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Access Security Settings: Go to Settings → Security → Authentication.
  2. Start 2FA Setup: Click Enable Two-Factor Authentication.
  3. Scan QR Code: Open your authenticator app and scan the QR code shown on screen.
    • If scanning fails, use the manual setup key displayed below the QR code.
  4. Verify Code: Enter the 6-digit code from your app and click Verify.
  5. Save Backup Codes: Download and store the backup codes shown, then click Done.
    • Backup codes are shown only once.

Store backup codes somewhere other than the device running your authenticator app.

title: How to Set Up VPN Access on Windows
content_html:
Overview

This article explains how to configure and connect to the company VPN on a Windows laptop.

Prerequisites

  • A company-issued laptop enrolled in device management.
  • Your network username and password.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Download VPN Client: Go to the internal software portal and download SecureConnect Client.
  2. Install Client: Run the installer and accept the default settings.
  3. Configure Server Address: Open the client and enter the server address vpn.company.internal.
  4. Authenticate: Enter your network username and password, then click Connect.
    • First-time connections may take up to 60 seconds to authorize.
  5. Confirm Connection: A status of CONNECTED appears in the client's top bar once the VPN is active.

title: How to Submit a New IT Support Ticket
content_html:
Overview

This article explains how to raise a new IT support ticket through the employee help portal.

Prerequisites

  • Access to the employee help portal with your company login.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Access Ticket Form: Go to Help Portal → New Ticket.
  2. Select Category: Choose the relevant category from the Issue Type dropdown.
    • Hardware, Software, Access Request, or Other.
  3. Describe the Issue: Enter a clear subject line and a detailed description of the issue.
    • Attach a screenshot if the issue is visual.
  4. Set Priority: Select the appropriate Priority level and click Submit.
  5. Track Ticket: Note the ticket reference (e.g. [TCK-1042]) shown on the confirmation screen.
keywords: submit a new it support ticket

title: How to Request Software Installation Approval
content_html:
Overview

This article explains how to request approval to install non-standard software on a company device.

Prerequisites

  • A business justification for the software request.
  • Manager's name for the approval step.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Access Software Catalog: Go to Help Portal → Software Catalog.
  2. Search for Software: Search for the software by name in the catalog search bar.
    • If not listed, select "Request New Software" instead.
  3. Submit Justification: Enter a business justification and click Request Approval.
  4. Await Manager Approval: Your manager receives an approval request with status PENDING_APPROVAL.
  5. Install Software: Once approved, return to the catalog and click Install.
    • Installation may require a device restart.

Approval requests typically take 1–2 business days depending on manager availability.

title: How to Connect to the Office Wi-Fi Network
content_html:
Overview

This article explains how to connect a personal or company device to the office Wi-Fi network.

Prerequisites

  • Device Wi-Fi enabled.
  • A valid company username and password.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Open Wi-Fi Settings: Go to your device's Settings → Wi-Fi.
  2. Select Network: Choose the network named CorpNet-Secure from the list.
  3. Enter Credentials: Enter your company username and password when prompted.
    • Use your full email address as the username.
  4. Trust Certificate: Click Trust when prompted to accept the network certificate.
  5. Confirm Connection: The Wi-Fi icon shows Connected once authentication succeeds.
keywords: connect to the office wi-fi network

title: How to Update Your Profile Information
content_html:
Overview

This article explains how to update your name, contact number, or department shown on your account profile.

Prerequisites

  • An active account with edit permissions on your own profile.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Access Profile: Go to Settings → Profile.
  2. Edit Details: Click Edit next to the field you want to change.
  3. Update Information: Enter the updated name, phone number, or department.
    • Email address changes require a separate verification step.
  4. Save Changes: Click Save to confirm the update.
  5. Verify Update: The updated details appear immediately on the Profile page.

title: How to Recover a Deleted File from OneDrive
content_html:
Overview

This article explains how to recover a file that was accidentally deleted from OneDrive.

Prerequisites

  • A OneDrive account with the file deleted within the last 30 days.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Access Recycle Bin: Go to OneDrive → Recycle Bin.
  2. Locate File: Search or scroll to find the deleted file by name.
    • Files older than 30 days may not appear and require an admin restore.
  3. Select File: Click the checkbox next to the file to select it.
  4. Restore File: Click Restore to return the file to its original folder.
  5. Confirm Recovery: A status of RESTORE_COMPLETE appears once the file is back in place.
keywords: recover a deleted file from onedrive

title: How to Configure Email Signature in Outlook
content_html:
Overview

This article explains how to create and set a default email signature in Outlook.

Prerequisites

  • Outlook desktop or web access with an active mailbox.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Access Signature Settings: Go to File → Options → Mail → Signatures.
  2. Create New Signature: Click New and enter a name for the signature.
  3. Enter Signature Content: Type or paste your signature text, including name, title, and contact details.
    • Use the formatting toolbar to add a logo image if required.
  4. Set Default Signature: Under Choose default signature, select the signature for New messages and Replies/forwards.
  5. Save Settings: Click OK to apply the signature.

title: How to Escalate a Ticket to a Senior Agent
content_html:
Overview

This article explains how an agent escalates an open ticket to a senior agent or specialist team.

Prerequisites

  • An open ticket assigned to you.
  • Escalation permissions enabled on your agent role.

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Open Ticket: Go to the ticket and click Escalate in the action bar.
  2. Select Escalation Reason: Choose a reason from the Escalation Reason dropdown.
    • Options include Technical Complexity, SLA Risk, or Customer Request.
  3. Add Escalation Note: Summarize the issue and the steps already attempted in the note field.
  4. Assign Escalation Group: Select the Senior Support group and click Confirm Escalation.
  5. Track Status: The ticket status changes to ESCALATED and appears in the senior queue.

Always add an escalation note — senior agents rely on it to avoid re-asking the customer for context already given.
keywords: escalate a ticket to a senior agent
